title: FOUNDATIONS OF PERSONAL FINANCE I
description: Part of Blueprint – a 12 course professional development course series to guide the student from college to career. Topics include foundations of personal finance, helping students navigate paying-for-college resources and aiding them in developing and sticking to a realistic budget while in school.
registration_restrictions:
Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Apparel Design (400)
  • Pre-Apparel (453)
  • Pre-Interiors (454)
  • Interior Design (458)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
